scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && vite build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.mkdirSync('extension/dist/icons',{recursive:true}); fs.copyFileSync('extension/manifest.json','extension/dist/manifest.json'); for(const f of ['icon16.png','icon48.png','icon128.png']) try{fs.copyFileSync('extension/icons/'+f,'extension/dist/icons/'+f)}catch(e){}"
scripts.extension:id: node scripts/get-extension-id.mjs extension/dist/manifest.json || node scripts/get-extension-id.mjs extension/manifest.json
scripts.verify: node scripts/get-extension-id.mjs extension/dist/manifest.json && cargo test --manifest-path native-host/Cargo.toml
scripts.cert:windows: npm run cert:native && npm run cert:failure && npm run cert:edge && npm run cert:chrome
